name: 4-in-1 Retractable Car Charger | Dual USB & USB-C PD Fast Charging, 100W
description:
The 4-in-1 Retractable Car Charger keeps your devices powered on the go. Featuring dual retractable cables, a USB-A port, and a USB-C PD fast-charging port, it supports up to 4 devices simultaneously with up to 100W for Type-C and 20W for iPhone. Its tangle-free, retractable design and 180° adjustable rotation make it convenient for any car setup, ensuring safe and efficient charging for all your devices during commutes or road trips.
Key Features
 4-in-1 charger with dual retractable cables, USB-A, and USB-C PD ports
 Fast charging up to 100W (Type-C) and 20W (iPhone)
 Built-in retractable cables for tangle-free, neat storage
 Adjustable 180° rotation for flexible car placement
 Universal compatibility with iPhone, Samsung, Google Pixel, and more
How to Use
 Plug the charger into your car’s cigarette lighter or power socket
 Connect your devices via retractable cables or USB ports
 Adjust the rotation for convenient access and use
 Unplug when fully charged or not in use
Material
High-quality ABS, PVC cables, electronic components
Safety Information
 For in-car use only
 Avoid exposure to water or moisture
 Do not overload beyond device limits
 Keep out of reach of children
Package Includes
 1 × 4-in-1 Retractable Car Charger
